source_note: Computed, not copied from a gazette: fixed-date holidays; Easter 28 March 2027 (Good Friday 26 March, Easter Monday 29 March); a holiday that falls on a Sunday is also observed on the Monday after it (Public Holidays Act), which applies to 10 Oct, 12 Dec and 26 Dec 2027. Eid dates are approximate (moon sighting). School-term breaks are NOT included for 2027: the term calendar was not available to verify, and an invented window would lift forecasts for no reason. Verify against the official gazette before relying on this.
